description: Every number of the shield feature. source 'bl2' = this value is (or will be) read from the player's Borderlands 2 files at install time and replaces the default here; 'design' = a Skylands choice with no Borderlands source yet. Rule from the user: when a Borderlands value for a design row is found, the row becomes 'bl2' and the file value replaces it. See docs/shield-roadmap.md.

columns.value: the default used when nothing was read from Borderlands 2
columns.bl2_object: the Borderlands 2 object that holds the real value ('-' when none is known yet); the deep shield survey dumps these in full
columns.read_verified: yes once the value was read from a real BL2 install (installer: skylands_setup.bl2.extract.shield_stats)

capacity of a shield with slot grade 0, as a share of the wearer's max health (BL2's own formula, 80 x 0.8 x 1.13^level, is a number of points that does not fit Skyrim's health); every grade then multiplies it by 1 + grade x grade_step_capacity
each slot grade adds this share to the capacity
each slot grade adds this share to the recharge rate

the shortest recharge delay an item can have (BL2 lets a very high delay grade reach zero)

a resistance capacitor (Maliwan fire/shock/corrosive, Torgue explosive) gives this much resistance to its element while the shield is worn (BL2: immunity to the element's status effect, which Skyrim has no equivalent of)
